title: Figma Agent
description: Figma's new AI agent lets designers prompt, edit, and prototype without leaving the canvas, significantly accelerating the design-to-implementation workflow. A major update that could reshape how designers collaborate with AI in their primary tool.

title: Emerging patterns: design leadership in 2026
description: A comprehensive research study from nearly 120 design leaders revealing key trends in leadership pathways, mentorship, portfolio careers, and tooling for 2026. This data-driven exploration provides actionable insights for anyone stepping into or aspiring to design leadership roles.

title: A Practical Guide To Naming Things
description: A comprehensive guide to naming UI components with practical conventions and structures that improve code maintainability and team collaboration. Essential reading for designers and developers working on scalable design systems.

title: Why designers need to stop reporting and start recommending at work
description: A thought-provoking piece challenging designers to shift from passive reporting to strategic recommendations that drive business outcomes. This reframes the designer's role as a strategic partner rather than executor.

title: How apps know us better than we do and influence our decisions
description: An exploration of how modern apps leverage data and metrics (Homo Metricus) to influence user behavior and decision-making in ways users often don't fully understand. Critical reading for designers concerned with ethical design practices.

title: E-cigarette & Vaping UX Benchmark: 3,600+ Performance Scores and 2,500+ Best Practice Examples
description: A comprehensive UX benchmark study analyzing 3,600+ performance scores across industry leaders, providing concrete best practices and design patterns for niche e-commerce categories. Valuable reference for designers building similar regulated or specialized product experiences.

title: Jev: How to use it for better, faster, and cheaper user decisions in UX
description: Introduces Jev, a decision model framework that enables interfaces to act, suggest, and ask at keystroke speed, reducing user friction and decision fatigue. A practical approach to embedding smarter decision-making into UX design.

title: On being anything other than a designer
description: A candid reflection on the burden of being the 'go-to person' in an organization for tasks beyond your core role, exploring the career and identity implications of scope creep. Resonates with designers navigating evolving responsibilities in their organizations.
